title: rumohra wallichii
intro: Rumohra wallichii, commonly known as the Palmatum Fern or Lady Palm, is a species of fern native to the Himalayas and parts of Asia. This plant is prized for its medicinal and ornamental value, with reported health benefits including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Rumohra wallichii include its use as a bronchodilator and anti-inflammatory agent, with its extracts exhibiting antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
